{"id":1778879082,"question_id":3242,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months","timestamp":1758530051,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1778879082/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Elements With Maximum Frequency","memory":"23.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maxFrequencyElements(vector<int>& nums) {\n        unordered_map<int,int>mp;\n\n        int total = 0;\n        int maxi = 0;\n\n        for(auto x : nums) mp[x]++;\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.second > maxi) maxi = it.second;\n        }\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.second >= maxi) total += it.second;\n        }\n    return total;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-elements-with-maximum-frequency","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":830}
